title: A leak in a crude-oil pipeline: when it is heard, where it is, and whether it was ever there
description: A 20 km, 400 mm crude line is solved by the method of characteristics from its steady state, with a pump curve upstream, a valve downstream and a hole as an internal boundary condition solved in closed form. Two sampled, quantised, noisy transmitters watch it, four instrument faults are injected into them, and a change-point detector on the residual against the nominal transient decides whether what happened was a hole, a broken instrument, or a valve nobody wrote down. The delay is compared with the flight time of the wave, the position with where the hole was drilled, and the false alarms are counted per hour of normal operation including two valve manoeuvres.

metrics.name: first_step_head_drop_at_the_hole
metrics.how: the head at the leak node one step after a 10 mm hole opens at 9.8 km, against a Q_L / (2 g A) = -1.261087 m; relative error 1.3e-12

metrics.name: first_step_split
metrics.how: the flow each side of the hole takes at that step, against Q_L/2 = 0.00136286 m^3/s; error 2.1e-12

metrics.name: front_speed
metrics.how: the width of the disturbance 8 s after the hole opens, against the Korteweg speed 1140.31 m/s

metrics.name: wave_attenuation_over_9.3_km
metrics.how: 1 - (peak at the transmitter)/(amplitude at the hole): 1.261 m at the hole, 0.877 m at the upstream transmitter, steady friction only

metrics.name: detection_delay_mid_line
metrics.how: median over six seeds of a 10 mm hole at 9.8 km; the wave needs (9800-480)/a = 8.17 s to reach the upstream transmitter

metrics.name: detection_delay_near_end
metrics.how: 10 mm hole at 3.0 km, 2.52 km from the upstream transmitter: flight time 2.21 s

metrics.name: localisation_error_median_accepted
metrics.how: median |estimate - truth| over the 72 of 144 case/seed combinations whose quieter front stood 2 sigma above the noise at its transmitter, decision interval 12 sigma

metrics.name: localisation_error_worst_accepted
metrics.how: the worst of those 72, an 8 mm hole at 15.5 km; the median error grows with the weaker front, 3.7 m at the middle of the line against 16.3 m at 15.5 km

metrics.name: positions_withheld
metrics.how: leaks whose quieter front was under 2 sigma: the leak and the rate are kept and the place is not guessed at

metrics.name: withheld_worst_error
metrics.how: what the withheld guesses would have said -- a 6 mm hole at 15.5 km whose far front was 0.87 sigma, timed 4.5 s late; the median of the 17 is 33.4 m

metrics.name: sampling_resolution
metrics.how: a dt_s / 2 for a 20 Hz acquisition: the position a single sample of the arrival is worth, before the interpolation inside the sample

metrics.name: leak_rate_error
metrics.how: median relative error of the estimate from the settled mass imbalance, 10 mm hole at 9.8 km, six seeds

metrics.name: false_alarms_per_hour
metrics.how: 60 records of 1 400 s (23.3 h) of normal operation with two valve manoeuvres the model knows, decision interval 12 sigma; 0.73/h at 8 sigma

metrics.name: minimum_detectable_leak
metrics.how: 2 g A sigma / (a (1 - attenuation)) with the measured 30 % attenuation: 0.22 % of the flow, a hole about 4.6 mm across; the measured floor is between 4 and 6 mm

metrics.name: instrument_faults_called_instrument
metrics.how: all six fault cases (bias either way, drift, extra noise, a latched channel at each end) on records of normal operation, six seeds each

metrics.name: unrecorded_manoeuvre_alarm_rate
metrics.how: the same 23.3 h of records judged against a model that was never told about the manoeuvres: 60 of 60 alarm, and 25 of them are called a leak

checks.name: the_leak_node_is_solved_not_iterated
checks.label: the first step after the hole opens matches the closed form H_L = H_0 - (B/2) C_v sqrt(H_L - H_amb) to 1.3e-12, and each side takes Q_L/2 to 2.1e-12

checks.name: the_front_travels_at_the_wave_speed
checks.label: the disturbance is 2 a t wide for t = 2, 4, 6, 8 s after the hole opens, 1 120-1 135 m/s against the Korteweg 1 140 m/s

checks.name: friction_is_what_shrinks_the_wave
checks.label: with f = 0 the transmitter sees exactly the head the hole dropped, 1.6038 m, to round-off; with this line's friction it sees 0.838 m

checks.name: the_delay_is_the_flight_time
checks.label: the median delay is within 0.15 s of the distance from the hole to the nearer transmitter divided by a, at all three positions and every hole from 6 mm up

checks.name: a_fault_is_not_a_leak
checks.label: six instrument faults, six seeds each: the verdict is 'instrument' every time and never 'leak'

checks.name: a_leak_is_not_a_fault
checks.label: every hole the detector heard was called a leak and the balance confirmed it

checks.name: quiet_in_normal_operation
checks.label: no alarm in 23.3 h of normal operation at a decision interval of 12 sigma, in 60 independent noise draws

checks.name: a_missed_front_is_not_placed
checks.label: a hole outside the two transmitters, or one whose quieter front is under 2 sigma, keeps its leak and its rate and is given no position: outside_transmitters / position_reliable say which
